version: 0.4.0
kind: slug
schema_type: core

metadata:
  udi: prismata.meta.schema.slug
  name: slug.schema
  description: Canonical schema defining slug rules for UDI identity.

spec:
  target_kind: slug
  naming:
    file_suffix: .schema.yaml
  versioning:
    semver: true

fields:
  - name: pattern
    path: pattern
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: maxLength
    path: maxLength
    type: integer
    required: true

  - name: allowSeparator
    path: allowSeparator
    type: boolean
    required: true

object:
  pattern: "^[a-z0-9-]+(\\|[a-z0-9-]+)*$"
  maxLength: 64
  allowSeparator: true
